briefdescription.para: Get the current usage status for a given device.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem for which usage status is in query
Device for which usage status need to be calculated

simplesect.para:
Usage status:
0: No subsystem is currently using the device
1: Only requesting subsystem is currently using the device
2: Only other subsystems are currently using the device
3: Both the current and at least one other subsystem is currently using the device

briefdescription.para: Update the device's state according to the current requirements from all subsystems.

parameterdescription.para: Device whose state is about to be updated

simplesect.para: Status of operation of updating device's state.

briefdescription.para: Gets the status of the given device for the requesting subsystem.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem querying the device status
ID of the device to query
Pointer that is updated with the device status

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: Find or allocate the runtime operations record for a device.

detaileddescription.para: Lazily creates the global operations list, resolves DeviceId, and returns an existing record when present. Otherwise it allocates a record, stores the device pointer, and prepends the record to the global list. Failures are logged.

parameterdescription.para: Device node identifier associated with the operations record.

simplesect.para: Pointer to the existing or newly allocated operations record; NULL if the device is absent or the record allocation fails.

briefdescription.para: Look up a runtime operations record by device identifier.

detaileddescription.para: Traverses the global operations list and compares the ID in each non-NULL record and device. The list and records are not modified.

parameterdescription.para: Device node identifier to find.

simplesect.para: Pointer to the first matching operations record, or NULL if the list is absent or no matching valid record exists.

parameterdescription.para: Processor whose subsystem needs to found

simplesect.para: Core must be requested from single subsystem. If it is requested from multiple subsystems then it returns only one subsystem ID and if it is not requested from any subsystem then this function returns maximum subsystem ID which is invalid.

briefdescription.para: Request a device on behalf of a subsystem, granting it the requested capabilities and quality of service.

detaileddescription.para: On success, updates the subsystem IPI mask when an IPI channel device is requested.

parameterdescription.para: Node ID of the requesting subsystem
Node ID of the device being requested
Requested device capabilities
Requested quality of service
Type of the command (secure or non-secure)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise

inbodydescription.para: More than one IPI channels can be associated with a subsystem; Update its IPI mask accordingly when an IPI channel is requested.

parameterdescription.para: Device for capability check
Capability

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if desired Caps is available in Device

briefdescription.para: Calculate the wake-up latency for a core device.

detaileddescription.para: A running core has zero latency. For a non-running core, the function adds the wake-up latency of its power node when one is present.

parameterdescription.para: Core device node ID
Non-NULL pointer to receive the latency; initialized to zero

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the latency is available, XST_INVALID_PARAM when no device exists for DeviceId, or an error from the power node latency query
